title: Audio
description: Audio file or recording with title, description, duration, format, playback statistics, and file URL. Used for audio hosting platforms, podcasts, sound libraries, and media management systems.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audio file

title.description: Title or name of the audio file

description.description: Description or summary of the audio content

url.description: URL or file path to the audio file

format.description: Audio file format (e.g., mp3, wav, ogg, m4a, flac)

plays.description: Total number of times the audio has been played

created_at.description: Timestamp when the audio file was uploaded or created
